run_double_dqn_atari_training: run the Double DQN agent training loop on an Atari environment like Pong with configurable hyperparameters
run_atari_training_with_custom_env: run the Double DQN Atari training with a custom environment name via the environment_name flag
run_atari_training_with_custom_seed: run the Double DQN Atari training with a custom random seed for reproducibility
run_atari_training_with_results_csv: run the Double DQN Atari training and log results to a custom CSV file path
run_atari_training_with_custom_iteration: run the Double DQN Atari training with a custom number of training iterations
